title: Kagamine Rin — Unspeakable Words〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, I hereby declare this meeting to discuss our strategy for the girls' training sessions open!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yay...? You know we're not here to play around, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We may actually come up with some nice ideas if we do try to have fun with this like her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So... Shiho asked us to teach her and the others how to play their instruments better.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. She said one-on-one sessions would be preferable...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But... Who's going to be looking at who?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's the issue at hand.
There are six of us and only four of them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, two of us are gonna get left out! That'd be way too sad!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, why don't we have those two move around freely?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Move around?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, they could roam between groups to see how everyone's doing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, that's a nice idea. I was just thinking one of us should sort of oversee everything.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I see... That could work...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However... I probably shouldn't be the one...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, KAITO, why not?
You seem like the one who'd see things the most objectively.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Each of the girls is going to have a tutor assigned to them, yes...? As they train and work together...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In time, their bond will grow stronger...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. That means our trust in one another will also increase.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. As nice as that may be...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure I can handle practicing with someone like that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You sure? I have a feeling that you'd do fine since the goal of this is to make them better performers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In any case, let's start thinking about who's going to be assigned to who.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd like to lead off by saying Honami asked me for some help, so I'd like to be assigned to her if possible.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I'd like to work with Ichika or Shiho. We already do a lot of sessions together, and know about each other's habits and tendencies.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm in the same boat.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm okay with anyone♪
It could be really fun to move around and see how everyone's doing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm.... I'm also okay with anyone. I can't really think of a good reason to be assigned to a particular person like you guys.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, KAITO, how about you?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um... I'm not sure I have a strong preference either...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Saki's still on the table.
If anything, I think Rin should be assigned to her since they get along so great.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Right...
However, in terms of training, there is one thing that's bothering me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's that?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We're all essentially able to play any instrument... That also means we don't specialize in any particular one.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's true...
I like playing certain instruments, but they're not necessarily my specialty...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm also worried about one person teaching someone for two weeks straight since they'd only be exposed to that tutor's style and knowledge...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... You bring up a good point.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, it's not a good idea to have the same teacher the entire time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we shuffle around?
You could be assigned to one person today, and someone else tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, don't kid around like...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Actually, that might be a really good idea...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. That way, one person's teaching style won't dominate.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. And as long as we report to each other what we do each day, we'll know how the girls are progressing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Also, even if these training sessions do get really tough, they'll get have some fun wondering who's going to be assigned to them for the day♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. Definitely!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It'd be easier for me if I were assigned to only one person...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, it would allow us to be ourselves...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We all see things from different perspectives, which should greatly benefit Ichika and the girls!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, does that mean...?!
We're going with my idea?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo! Do the tutor shuffle!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, now we need to discuss who's going to be assigned to who first!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!
